doors.label: l'escalier
doors.hint: Up to the red door on the balcony

doors.label: la fresque
doors.hint: Up to the orange door on the balcony

doors.label: le calendrier
doors.hint: Up to the yellow door on the balcony

doors.label: les semaines
doors.hint: Up to the green door on the balcony

doors.label: le palier
doors.hint: Up to the teal door on the balcony

doors.label: le cadran
doors.hint: Up to the blue door on the balcony

doors.label: la galerie
doors.hint: Up to the purple door on the balcony

doors.label: le sommet
doors.hint: Up to the pink door on the balcony

zooms.label: la place
zooms.hint: Look closer through the arch onto the village square

horloge.alt: The clock hall at the foot of the village clock tower, painted in ink and gouache: the big wooden front door on the far left leads back out to the village square, seen through a stone arch with its fountain; a wall clock with dots for hours hangs above a balcony with eight colored doors (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple and pink); down in the courtyard a puzzled man sits on a bench staring at a giant pocket watch, a grumpy little boy on a stool hugs a big nut and will not share it, a gnu lies asleep on the floor with a nightcap hung on its horn beside a glowing crescent-moon lantern, a traveler with a suitcase and walking stick sets off through a back archway, a doorman in a red uniform holds up a smiling sun in another archway, a sunbather in sunglasses lounges in a deckchair by an hourglass, and a man pauses beside his red lawnmower.

place.name: La place du village · Village Square
place.alt: Close-up through the arch onto the village square: a white swan glides on a little round fountain pond, a man does yoga on his blue mat as the sun rises behind him, and a man snaps an instant camera with a bright flash.

escalier.name: L'escalier · Staircase

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Back through the sun door to the clock hall

zooms.label: l'alcôve
zooms.hint: Look closer into the alcove under the stairs

zooms.label: la classe
zooms.hint: Climb the little steps through the arch into the tower schoolroom

escalier.alt: The tower stairway, painted in ink and gouache: a boy shrugs beside his big red lorry, a singer in a black gown bows among roses, two old sweethearts hold hands on a bench, a boy crosses his arms beside a giant jam jar, a granny slams a big red button holding a stopwatch, and a baker in a nightcap rushes in with a tart and a candle. An alcove under the stairs holds an armchair; the arched door with the sun leads back to the clock hall. Through the tall stone arch at the top right, a few steps lead up into a little schoolroom with a blackboard and two children at their desks.

alcove.name: L'alcôve de l'escalier · Stair Alcove
alcove.alt: Close-up into the alcove under the stairs: two identical gray cats stare at each other through an empty mirror frame, an old man with a beard down to the floor sits in a cobwebbed armchair, a sleepy man in striped pajamas and a nightcap yawns on his packed suitcase, holding up his alarm clock, his bowler hat and umbrella ready beside him, and a girl holds fresh daisies and a sunny mug.

fresque.name: La fresque du temps · Fresco of Time

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Back through the open wooden door to the clock hall

zooms.label: la scène
zooms.hint: Look closer at the little stage

fresque.alt: The timeline mural room, painted in ink and gouache: a stork flies a baby bundle across the painted wall; a girl waves her fan, a 1920s flapper pokes a gramophone, a baby shakes a rattle in her pram and a grandmother, mother and daughter walk hand in hand; a boy drops a chequered flag as two boys race off, a man cups his ear to a crystal ball, and a grandpa shows his old photo album. A little curtained stage stands on the right; the open wooden door on the left leads back to the clock hall.

scene.name: La scène de la fresque · Fresco Scene
scene.alt: Close-up of the little stage: a girl holds a chick hatching from its egg, a grandma in a rocking chair holds a cream cake, a woman stretches out her accordion, a boy shouts on his first day on stage, a man at a desk spins a wheel of fortune, and a wizard in a starry robe casts a sparkling spell.

calendrier.name: Le calendrier · Calendar

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Back through the arched wooden door to the clock hall

calendrier.alt: The calendar room, painted in ink and gouache: a white horse neighs beside a big spoked wheel, a girl with balloons stands by a cream cake, ants haul little chairs toward a circled day on the wall calendar, a little surfer rides a wave under the moon's phases, a girl cheers over a crate of strawberries and pumpkins, a giant ant blows out birthday candles, a man in a straw hat sips an iced tea in his deckchair and a man in a fur coat shivers beside a snowman. The arched wooden door on the left leads back to the clock hall; a window looks out on the village.

fenetre.name: La fenêtre du calendrier · Calendar Window
fenetre.alt: Close-up through the calendar room window onto the village square: a girl sprinkles a salt shaker over four little trees, blossoming, green, orange and snowy; across the square a man prints sheets of flowers on a printing press, a girl dances round a maypole, a man waves a sparkler and an octopus juggles pumpkins among falling leaves.

semaines.name: Les jours de la semaine · Days of the Week

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Back through the green door to the clock hall

zooms.label: le balcon
zooms.hint: Look closer out onto the balcony and the market street

semaines.alt: The days-of-the-week room, painted in ink and gouache: a girl in a sailor dress holds a seven-day pill box, a boy throws a dart into the wall calendar, a paperboy brings a magazine with a sun picture, a grandpa plays dominoes, a man in his Sunday best munches a croissant, a smart little boy with a bouquet checks his pocket watch, a yawning boy carries a moon lunchbox and a man snoozes in a hammock. The green door on the left leads back to the clock hall; open French doors lead onto a balcony.

balcon.name: Le balcon du marché · Market Balcony
balcon.alt: Close-up from the balcony onto the market street: a boy skates to market with his basket, a man carries a basket of strawberries, a schoolboy walks with a new brown satchel and a fishmonger pushes a little blue handcart of fish.

palier.name: Le palier · Landing

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Back through the teal door to the clock hall

zooms.label: la fenêtre
zooms.hint: Look closer through the open window

palier.alt: The landing, painted in ink and gouache: a girl in a sailor dress turns over a giant leaf, a knight in armor cradles a jade statuette, and a barefoot woman holds a sun hat in one hand and an umbrella in the other. A wooden staircase climbs at the back, open French doors look out on the village, and the teal door on the left leads back to the clock hall.

marches.name: Les marches du palier · Landing Steps
marches.alt: Close-up of the landing staircase: a man in a gray suit sips his coffee on a step, a boy reads a scroll so long it unrolls down the stairs, and a kneeling man winds a metronome.

lucarne.name: La fenêtre du palier · Landing Window
lucarne.alt: Close-up through the open window of the landing: a man packs a parachute into a van, a general with a chest full of medals points, a boy who has just won a race stands beside a puffing man, and a man squints at a four-leaf clover through a magnifying glass.

cadran.name: Le cadran · Clock Face

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Back through the blue door to the clock hall

zooms.label: le salon
zooms.hint: Look closer through the archway into the music room

cadran.alt: The clock-face room, painted in ink and gouache: an oar leans on a giant wall clock with dots for hours; a lady in a feathered hat holds her ticket and opera glasses, a woman polishes a pan beside a little mantel clock, a lark sings in its cage, a jogger runs with a rooster on his shoulder, a hen sits on her nest beside an hourglass, a man eats a crêpe by a pink dusk window and a latecomer dashes in clutching his clock. An archway on the right opens onto a music room; the blue door on the left leads back to the clock hall.

salon.name: Le salon de musique · Music Room
salon.alt: Close-up through the archway into the music room: a pianist plays at a grand piano, a girl holds up her trophy again and an old wizard carries a cake with a forest of candles.

galerie.name: La galerie des époques · Gallery of the Ages

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Back through the purple door to the clock hall

zooms.label: la terrasse
zooms.hint: Look closer through the glass doors onto the terrace

galerie.alt: The gallery of eras, painted in ink and gouache: a girl steps out of a hedge maze, a cavewoman holds a huge dinosaur egg, a woman spins at a starry wheel, a phoenix rises from its flames, a girl holds a mask before her face over an open book, a mayor cuts a red ribbon and a boy pulls out a long ladder on a trestle. Glass doors on the right open onto a terrace; the purple door on the left leads back to the clock hall.

terrasse.name: La terrasse · Terrace
terrasse.alt: Close-up through the glass doors onto the sunny terrace: an old lady holds a new frying pan and her piggy bank, a girl kneels holding up a big paintbrush, a woman with a microphone waves hello, a woman on one knee shows her bracelets, an old man fishes from his deckchair, and a boy unwraps a shiny new red bicycle.

sommet.name: Le sommet de la tour · Top of the Tower

doors.label: le hall
doors.hint: Back through the pink door to the clock hall

zooms.label: la fenêtre
zooms.hint: Look closer through the window at the top of the tower

sommet.alt: The top of the tower under the great bell, painted in ink and gouache: a granny in a rocking chair knits a scarf that coils across the floor, an usher stands by a red curtain behind a rope, a boy films with an old camera and a flash, and a boy gapes as his toast falls butter side down. The pink door on the left leads back to the clock hall; an arched window on the right looks out to sea.

vue.name: La vue du sommet · View from the Top
vue.alt: Close-up through the arched window at the top of the tower onto a green hill by the sea: a hamster runs in its wheel in a cage, a man in a green cap sits at the door of a little orange tent, a milkman carries a crate of milk bottles, a man on a bench feeds a pigeon, and a lighthouse on the hilltop flashes its lantern.

classe.name: La salle de classe · Tower Schoolroom
classe.alt: A cozy stone schoolroom up the tower steps, with a blank green blackboard, an arched window and a round window, a coat peg with a satchel and bookshelves with a globe: a honeybee hovers over a closed tulip bud on a wall shelf; a boy holds up a toy camper van covered in travel stickers; a white-bearded old schoolmaster listens through a brass ear trumpet to a drooping wilted rose; a boy dressed as a little lord mayor in a red robe and gold chain; a girl watches a row of dominoes topple one after another; a girl opens a big shell with a pearl inside; a boy sleeps on a chair with an alarm clock tied to his big toe; a boy holds an antique brass toy car; two children speak into a microphone beside an old radio with a glowing red lamp; a boy putts a golf ball toward a toy hole; and a dismayed boy kneels by a knocked-over flowerpot with spilled soil and a rose.
